title: Everton Blair Jr. Wins Race to Fill David Scott’s House Seat in Georgia
summary: Everton Blair Jr. will serve until January in the seat long held by Mr. Scott, who died in April. Mr. Blair is not competing in the general election for the next full term in the deep-blue district.
